# The engine's `idempotency-ap-v1` route set (U-83 to U-87): the A/P
# document mutations its openapi.json marks `x-idempotency: true` on top of
# `idempotency-v1`, recorded from engine main f3ce33fd (PR #173) and listed
# in its docs/DESKTOP.md "Request idempotency". Append-only for this
# capability name. tests/spec_fixtures.rs checks that the pinned engine
# marks exactly idempotency_v1_routes.txt plus these.
#
# P17 covers all six: each is `keyable-ap` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::ApV1`), and its key is sent and replayed only while the engine
# advertises `idempotency-ap-v1` (an engine with only `idempotency-v1` does
# not replay these).
POST /api/v1/bill-payments/{id}/void
POST /api/v1/bills/{id}/void
POST /api/v1/vendor-credits
POST /api/v1/vendor-credits/{id}/void
PUT /api/v1/bills/{id}
PUT /api/v1/vendor-credits/{id}
